about: The one colour scheme of the game's screens and the website: black and white with greys between, and three highlights. yorehold-web/app/theme.css and src/hud/Palette.cs hold the same values. Pictures and the map's art keep their own colours.

gold.use: the main action, what is picked, scores and ranks

red.use: danger, enemies, damage and hit points lost

blue.use: information, links, allies, healing and good news
